newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil fixes shutdown at Sleipner field.
newsitem.headline: Statoil fixes shutdown at Sleipner field.

text.p: The Sleipner East and West condensate and gas fields in the North Sea will close for scheduled maintenance between August 7 and August 19, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday.
In June the two developments had an average throughput of 169,543 barrels of condensate and natural gas liquids (NGLs) per day, according to Statoil's latest figures.
Gas from the two fields is sold under the Troll sales agreements. Condensate is piped to the Kaarstoe terminal on the west coast of Norway.
